title: Bodo Oral Histories, Ancient Dynasties & Political Accords

ancient_kingdoms.overview: Ruled by Kachari kings across the Dhansiri valley and Cachar hills. Left magnificent monolith pillar monuments at Dimapur, palace fortifications at Maibang, and river palaces at Khaspur.
Close kinship between Koch and Mech lineages culminating in the military genius of General Chilarai and Maharaj Nara Narayana, patronizing early vernacular translations.

modern_political_accords.significance: First formal tripartite accord establishing administrative autonomy for Bodo areas north of the Brahmaputra.

modern_political_accords.accord: Bodoland Territorial Council (BTC) Sixth Schedule Accord
modern_political_accords.significance: Historic accord creating the autonomous Bodoland Territorial Region (BTR) under the Sixth Schedule of the Indian Constitution, directly accompanied by Bodo language recognition under the Eighth Schedule.
Landmark peace accord signed between the Union Government, Assam State, and all NDFB factions, securing comprehensive cultural, economic, and educational development.
